parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can specify an asterisk (\*) as the value to match all applications that belong to the domain name.

parameters.name: DelayTime
parameters.description: The duration for which the playback of the live stream is delayed. The value must be an integer. Valid values: 16 to 3600. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can use the wildcard (\*) to specify all streams of the application.

parameters.name: TaskTriggerMode
parameters.description:
The trigger mode. Valid values:

*   **PUBLISH_ONLY**: Stream delay can be triggered only by specifying the stream delay parameter in the ingest URL.
*   **CONFIG_ONLY**: Stream delay can be triggered only by the stream delay configuration.
*   **PUBLISH_CONFIG**: Stream delay can be triggered by the stream delay parameter in the ingest URL or the stream delay configuration. The stream delay parameter takes precedence over the stream delay configuration.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-delay-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain example.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStream0000 --delay-time 60 --task-trigger-mode PUBLISH_ONLY --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UpdateLiveDelayConfig --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --TaskTriggerMode PUBLISH_ONLY --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com' --DelayTime 60
